shareholders.evidence: is to maximize Berkshire’s average annual rate of gain in intrinsic business value on a per-share basis

integrity.evidence: We will be candid in our reporting to you, emphasizing the pluses and minuses important in appraising business value.

result.analyst_notes: First-person, plainspoken letter from Chairman Buffett with Munger ('Charlie and I'). Shareholders are addressed first and most, framed as owner-partners, with per-share intrinsic value dominant. Commitments mix absolute ('we will never', 'we can guarantee') with hedged ('we expect', 'no guarantee'). Candor and conservatism recur. Employees, communities and environment are essentially absent.
